top: Butterflies sometimes land on a caiman's face and drink its tears
comment: They do it for the sodium in the tears. It even has a name: lachryphagy. The caiman just has to sit there and take it.
topic_it: Farfalle che bevono le lacrime di un caimano per il sodio (lacrifagia)
photo_it: Farfalle sulla testa di un caimano (via Bored Panda)
title: Why caimans let butterflies drink their tears #nature #science #animals
description:
Butterflies sometimes drink the tears of caimans to get sodium, a behavior called lachryphagy.
